dimensions.label: Abortion Rights Movement
dimensions.description: A social and political movement advocating for the legal right to abortion, often framed as a matter of personal autonomy and bodily integrity. The phrase 'my body my choice' is a central slogan of this movement, emphasizing that individuals should have the right to make decisions about their own reproductive health without government interference. The meme's depiction of erasing 'Abortion' directly opposes this movement and its core principles.

dimensions.label: Reproductive Autonomy
dimensions.description: The concept that individuals have the right to make decisions about their own reproductive health, including the choice to have or not have children, and access to reproductive healthcare services such as contraception and abortion. This concept is foundational to the 'my body my choice' slogan and is directly challenged by the visual metaphor of erasure in the meme.

dimensions.label: Anti-Abortion Activism

The visual of erasing 'Abortion' in the meme is a common tactic used by anti-abortion activists to symbolize the removal or rejection of abortion as a legal or moral option.
